gloss: Syene, city on southern border of Egypt, toward Ethiopia
definition: [ סְוֵן , < סְרָן ], סְוֵנֵה proper name, of a location Syene, city on southern border of Egypt, toward Ethiopia , only in phrase ( וְעַדגְּֿבוּל כּוּשׁ ) ׳ מִמִּגְדֹּל ס Ezek 29:10 compare Ezek 30:6 , read probably סְוֵ֫נָה or < סְוָ֫נָה (Coptic Suan ), with ה locative ( JDMich Sm Co Berthol ) = Egyptian Sun , Coptic Suan , modern Aswân ; ᵐ5 ἔως Συηνης ; read probably סְוָן also Ezek 30:16 (for ᵑ0 סִין q. v.) ᵐ5 Συηνη . — See further Jos BJ «JOSEPHUS:Wars of the Jews 4:10»iv. 10 , 5 Strabo xxxii.817-820, Brugsch Geogr. Inscr. i. 155; Reiseber. aus Aegypt. 247 Bd Egypt.4.323f. Budge Nile 284 .

[סְוֵן, < סְרָן], סְוֵנֵה proper name, of a location Syene, city on southern border of Egypt, toward Ethiopia, only in phrase (וְעַדגְּֿבוּל כּוּשׁ) ׳מִמִּגְדֹּל ס Ezek 29:10 compare Ezek 30:6, read probably סְוֵ֫נָה or < סְוָ֫נָה (Coptic Suan), with ה locative (JDMich Sm Co Berthol) = Egyptian Sun, Coptic Suan, modern Aswân; ᵐ5 ἔως Συηνης; read probably סְוָן also Ezek 30:16 (for ᵑ0 סִין q. v.) ᵐ5 Συηνη. — See further JosBJ «JOSEPHUS:Wars of the Jews 4:10»iv. 10, 5 Straboxxxii.817-820, BrugschGeogr. Inscr. i. 155; Reiseber. aus Aegypt. 247 BdEgypt.4.323f. BudgeNile 284.
